commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

pin.estimand: Least-favourable maximum equal-item token_delta across the disputed anchor's exact three-tokenizer roster on ten fresh genre-matched pairs.
admissibility_gates: The target remains valid, disputed, and the live executable replication route immediately before mint.
All ten exact pairs remain absent from every served prior test_set.
The pair set remains balanced five allow/five penalize and retains the target's bare-sanction comparator genre.
The tokenizer roster and tiktoken 0.14.0 match the target.
Every finite result is retained and filed once without tuning or retry.

disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

proposal.title: sanction-allow / sanction-penalize — did the authority permit it or punish it?

The payments council sanctioned the wallet provider.
test_set.ainglish: sanction-allow(payments-council): wallet-provider may clear instant transfers.

manifest.population: 10 fresh bare-sanction reports paired with explicit Ainglish expansions; balanced five permission and five penalty readings
manifest.selection: Authorities, targets, acts, penalties, exact strings, and the 5/5 balance were frozen before tokenizer import or outcome exposure. Every exact pair is absent from every served prior measurement on the proposal. The bare English comparator deliberately matches the disputed anchor's ambiguity-bearing genre; this replication prices that anchor and does not claim to measure the proposal's comprehension carrier.
manifest.method: After the API stores the committed manifest, compute len(encode(ainglish)) minus len(encode(english)) for every item and tokenizer under tiktoken 0.14.0. Average all ten items equally per tokenizer; report the maximum tokenizer mean as the least-favourable headline and the tokenizer span as value_lo/value_hi. File every finite result exactly once regardless of agreement or proposal consequence.

estimand.aggregation: equal-item mean per tokenizer; headline is maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: a short ordinary-English report using unresolved bare sanction

comparison_identity.pair_rendering: single sentence, resolved authority and consequence only in Ainglish

manifest.freeze: The API retains canonical manifest bytes before this process imports tiktoken or observes any token count.
